KONUM: Al Maqt'a, Kalba, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates. İrtifa: 3 m.
YAKIN ÇEVRE: Market: Ahmed Al Maghribi (683 m), Sharjah Coop (747 m). Akaryakıt: ادنوك (4,8 km). Sağlık: Al Zaytoon (5,8 km). Yerleşim: المقطة (878 m), القلهة (2,0 km). Zirve: Jabal Hafarah جبل احفرة (6,7 km), Jabal al Qusīy (7,1 km). Görülecek: Wildlife observation (3,7 km), Al Hafiya Lagoon (6,5 km), الحدائق المعلقة (7,5 km). Yakın tesis: Kingfisher Sharjah Retreat (662 m), بريز موتل (785 m).

Memeliler: Vulpes vulpes (Kızıl Tilki), Funambulus pennantii (Northern Palm Squirrel), Delphinus delphis (tirtak), Lepus capensis. Bitkiler: Avicennia marina, Halocnemum strobilaceum, Aerva javanica, Tetraena hamiensis, Tetraena simplex.
ÇEVRE BİLGİSİ (Wikipedia, Kalba Mangrove reserve, 2,0 km): Kalba Mangrove reserve is a natural reserve to a protected natural mangrove forest located in Kalba, Sharjah. Conservation efforts around the mangrove have sought to protect the declining populations of white-collared kingfisher birds that inhabit the area.
